Overview

Nuremberg is a city in Bavaria with a population of 518,000. A medieval gem in Bavaria, famous for its imperial castle, Christmas market, gingerbread, and rich history as a toy-making capital. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
